name: Misawa Kouta
source: Recent college graduate working at the city hall, got married somewhat impulsively when his wife became pregnant and feels pressured into the relationship. While he doesn't dislike his wife, he's sexually frustrated due to not having a sexual relationship since having a child. Interested in finding other ways to satisfy his needs but has limited spending money. Despite these challenges, he genuinely loves and cares for his child and is supportive in terms of parenting.
